name: Fast-Casual Commerce
purpose: An original, conversion-focused visual and interaction direction for food ordering and multi-branch restaurant commerce.
typographyAttitude: clear commerce sans with compact product, price, and status hierarchy
colourAttitude: neutral food canvas with one energetic brand action colour and restrained semantic status colours
surfaceAttitude: clean catalog surfaces, minimal decorative chrome, selective elevation for active commerce objects
imageryAttitude: consistent, realistic product photography with controlled lighting, angle, crop, and background
coreMoves: Keep product images, names, prices, and actions visible without requiring long reading.
Use sticky context sparingly for branch, fulfilment, categories, and cart.
Use one dominant action colour for add, continue, and checkout actions.
Use compact metadata and status labels instead of explanatory paragraphs.
Make the mobile customiser and cart feel native and task-focused.
Use motion for selection, addition, recalculation, validation, and progress—not decoration.
avoid: oversized marketing type inside the ordering flow
repeated hero photography throughout the experience
equal visual weight for every product and promotion
